units.source_text: 夕雾回到三条院自邸，看见房间的格子门等都已关上，人都睡静了。

en.t: Yugiri returned to his own residence at Sanjo-in and saw that the room's lattice shutters and everything else had already been closed, and that everyone was sleeping in silence.

units.source_text: 想是有人告诉云居雁，说夕雾爱上了落叶公主，和她十分亲昵，因此云居雁看见夕雾深夜不归，心中生气，此时听见他回来了，故意装作睡觉吧。

en.t: Someone must have told Kumoi no Kari that Yugiri had fallen in love with Princess Ochiba and had become very intimate with her; so when she saw that he did not return until late at night, she was angry, and now, hearing him come back, she was probably pretending to be asleep on purpose.

units.source_text: 夕雾用美妙的嗓子独自吟唱催马乐“小妹与我入山中……”。

en.t: With his beautiful voice, Yugiri sang a saibara song to himself: "The young maiden and I go into the mountains..."

units.source_text: 唱罢，恨恨地说：“为什么都关上了？

en.t: When he had finished singing, he said resentfully, "Why has everything been shut up?

units.source_text: 好气闷哪！

en.t: How stifling it is!

units.source_text: 今夜这么好的月亮，竟有人不要看啊！”

en.t: On a night with such a beautiful moon, how can anyone not want to look at it!"

units.source_text: 便把格子门打开，又把帘子卷起，在窗前躺下，对云居雁说：“这么好的月夜，也有肯安心睡觉的人？

en.t: Then he opened the lattice shutters, rolled up the blinds, lay down by the window, and said to Kumoi no Kari, "On such a fine moonlit night, is there really anyone who can sleep in peace?

units.source_text: 唉，太没意思了！”

en.t: Ah, how dull that is!"

units.source_text: 云居雁心中不快，置之不理。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari was displeased and paid no attention to him.

units.source_text: 许多无知无识的孩子，东一个西一个地睡着，许多侍女也挤在一起躺着。

en.t: Many small children, still too young to understand anything, were asleep here and there, and many waiting women were lying crowded together as well.

units.source_text: 夕雾看了这人口热闹的状态，回想刚才一条院的光景，两相比较，觉得大不相同。

en.t: Seeing this bustling household full of people, Yugiri thought back to the scene at Ichijo-in a short while before, and when he compared the two, he felt how utterly different they were.

units.source_text: 他拿起那支笛来吹了一会，躺卧着回想：“我走之后，那边多么冷清！

en.t: He picked up that flute and played it for a while, then lay there thinking, "After I left, how lonely it must be over there!

units.source_text: 那张琴大约没有变调，仍在那里弹吧。

en.t: That koto has probably not gone out of tune and is still being played there.

units.source_text: 老夫人也是个和琴名手呢。

en.t: The old lady, too, is a master of the wagon.

units.source_text: ……”又想：“为什么柏木只在表面上尊重这公主，而对她没有深挚的爱情呢？

en.t: ..." Then he thought again, "Why did Kashiwagi show this princess only outward respect, without feeling any deep love for her?

units.source_text: 这一点实在令人难解。

en.t: That is truly hard to understand.

units.source_text: 倘想象得很美，而一见大失所望，倒是不幸之事。

en.t: If one imagines someone as very beautiful and then is terribly disappointed on meeting her, that is an unfortunate thing.

units.source_text: 世间常例，凡大名鼎鼎的，往往教人失望。

en.t: As often happens in the world, anything with a great reputation is apt to disappoint people.

units.source_text: 如此想来，我们夫妻从小相亲相爱，多年以来，从无半点龃龉，实在是难得的。

en.t: Thinking of it that way, it is truly rare that my wife and I have been close and loving since childhood, and for all these years have never had the slightest discord.

units.source_text: 怪不得她要如此骄矜了。”

en.t: No wonder she is so proud."
